ops.whyShort: The Shen'dralas bracket was unpublished. Questie levels on the kept chain are the low 40s. 93125 has no pre, but its text still says to maintain Gelkis standing, and 1373 is not on the route.
ops.original: Shen'dralas has no published level bracket, so treat the band as unverified. Going Home does not list 1373, but it still asks for Gelkis standing.

ops.whyShort: 8276, 8277, and 8280 have empty pre lists and stay. Their next quests are 20 Dredge Crushers, more stingers, a satchel, 8 tablet fragments, and 10 encrypted texts.
ops.original: Stop Silithus after Securing the Supply Lines and Deadly Desert Venom. Do not take the crusher, tablet, encrypted-text, or Silithyst follow-ups.
